messages:
Maria: quick async — migration status + ownership ask for the v2 cutover next Wed. TL;DR: we need routing owner, SDK lead, infra capacity commit, and QA smoke owners. Not looking for long replies here, just confirmations and PR numbers. @Devon @Ash @Samir @Priya

Devon: I can own routing and canary slice mapping. Will coordinate the routing rule changes and add the mapping table to the runbook.

Ash: I’ll own SDK compatibility (js + py). Can someone paste the final header contract here? Need to validate serialization for embeddings params.

Maria: header contract: `X-Redwood-API-Version: v2` (required), optional `X-Embeddings-Params` (JSON). Also note we tightened `Content-Type` to `application/redwood+json` for v2 responses.

Samir: infra check — Dedicated pool looks good but we need a capacity commit for peak 200 RPS during cutover window or else we fallback to routing ~10% of traffic to inference-low (quantized) variants. Also need an ETA for the autoscaler tweak (PR link below).

Maria: fallback policy (short): if latency > 1200ms for 3m, route 20% traffic to fallback-model; if error rate > 1% for 5m, rollback to v1 endpoints automatically.

Priya: QA will run smoke on canary slices Mon/Tue. Uploading the test plan to the checklist. Need PR numbers so we can track regressions in the pipeline.

Devon: adding CR queue link and my initial triage: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pulls?q=is:pr+label:migration. Will prioritize routing rules + gate changes.

CI Bot: Build #6432 — `sdk-js` unit tests: 12 failures (mostly header parsing). Full log: https://ci.redwood/build/6432/logs

Ash: seeing the CI failures, will open #5123 to fix header parsing edgecases (flaky JSON parse for `X-Embeddings-Params`).

Maria: action items for checklist (I’ll update the doc after confirmations): 1) routing owner — Devon; 2) SDK owner — Ash; 3) infra capacity commit — Samir; 4) QA smoke lead — Priya; 5) CR triage — Devon. Please confirm here by EOD. :thumbsup:

Devon: confirmed. PRs to watch: #4978 (routing rules), #5011 (canary config).

Ash: confirmed. Filing #5123 now to address CI flakes, will ping when green.

Samir: confirmed. Reserved burst pool and posting autoscaler PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5130.

Priya: confirmed. Test plan uploaded to the checklist doc: https://docs.redwood/test-plans/v2-cutover.

Maria: perfect — thanks. Quick follow-up: can everyone add one-line rollback criteria to their PR description? We want clear rollback signals for the oncall. If anything blocks you, flag it here.

Devon: added rollback section to #4978.

Ash: adding rollback note to #5123.

Samir: added health check thresholds to #5130.

Priya: QA will add smoke pass/fail gates to the checklist and link to the canary dashboards.

Maria: awesome. I’ll run a dry-run Thursday morning and post results. If you want to sync live instead, ping me and we’ll schedule a 15m. Thanks all!
